source.k210.name: K210 board (Maixduino / Maix Bit)
source.k210.desc: Connect a K210 board (MaixPy v1) with a USB cable to see its camera live. The board can also run a detection or classification model by itself.
source.k210.param.port: Serial port (leave empty to find automatically)
source.k210.param.baud: Connection speed (usually no need to change)
control.k210.send_every: Send one image every N frames (0 = data only)
source.k210.err.no_port: No USB serial port for a K210 board was found.
source.k210.err.many_ports: Several possible serial ports were found ({ports}). Please choose one when adding the camera.
source.k210.err.port_missing: Serial port {port} was not found. The USB cable may have been unplugged.
source.k210.err.port_busy: Serial port {port} is being used by another program, so it cannot be opened.
source.k210.err.port_denied: You do not have permission to use serial port {port}.
source.k210.err.start_timeout: The board did not start sending images within {seconds} seconds.
source.k210.err.start_failed:
The board could not start streaming. It reported:
{text}
source.k210.err.model_missing:
The model file is not on the board. Use "Load on-board model" to upload it first.
{text}
source.k210.err.out_of_memory:
The board ran out of memory. Try a smaller resolution or a smaller model.
{text}
source.k210.err.no_kpu: This board's firmware has no KPU (neural network accelerator), so it cannot run a model.
source.k210.err.no_sd: No SD card was detected on the board, so the model cannot be stored in /sd/. Insert an SD card or use /flash/ instead.
source.k210.err.not_open: The K210 is not open yet.
source.k210.err.not_streaming: The board is not streaming right now. Press Retry to reconnect.
source.k210.err.lost: The connection to the board was lost.
source.k210.err.stalled: The board has not sent any data for a long time.
source.k210.err.board_error:
The program on the board hit an error and stopped:
{text}
source.k210.err.unknown_control: The K210 has no setting called "{key}".
source.k210.err.rejected: The board did not accept this setting: {detail}
source.k210.err.no_ack: The setting was sent but the board did not reply, so it cannot be confirmed.
source.k210.err.reconnect_failed: The board did not reconnect after rebooting.
source.k210.hint.linux_dialout: In a terminal run "sudo usermod -a -G dialout $USER", then log out and log in again.
source.k210.hint.close_other_app: Close any other program using this serial port (another EdgeLens window, a terminal running miniterm, the Arduino serial monitor), then press Retry.
source.k210.hint.press_reset: Press the RESET button on the board, or unplug and re-plug the USB cable, wait a few seconds, then press Retry.
source.k210.hint.check_cable: Make sure the USB cable is plugged in firmly and can carry data (some cables only charge).
source.k210.progress.up_to_date: The board already has the same model file
source.k210.progress.starting: Loading the model and restarting the stream...
source.k210.action.bad_args: The action is missing required input: {error}
source.k210.action.no_device_path: This model's card has no on-board path (device.path), for example /flash/model.kmodel.
source.k210.action.model_not_found: {path} is not on the board and no model file was found on this computer to upload.
source.k210.action.model_unloaded: Unloaded the on-board model. The board now only sends images.
source.k210.action.bad_freq: Processor and KPU speeds must be between 100 and 600 MHz.
source.k210.action.freq_done: Processor speed set. The board rebooted and reconnected.
source.k210.flash.need_kflash: Flashing needs the kflash package, which is not installed. Run "pip install kflash" in EdgeLens's environment, or run the installer again.
source.k210.flash.cancelled: Flashing was cancelled. The firmware on the board may be incomplete; flash it again before using the board.
source.k210.flash.reopen: Wait 5 seconds for the board to boot, then open this camera again.
source.k210.flash.err.permission: No permission to use the serial port. On Linux, add yourself to the dialout group and log in again.
source.k210.flash.err.busy: The serial port is being used by another program. Close it first.
source.k210.flash.err.nofile: The firmware file (.bin) was not found.
source.k210.flash.err.port: Cannot open the serial port. Check the USB cable and that the right port is selected.
source.k210.flash.err.isp: The board did not respond as expected while flashing. Unplug and re-plug the USB cable, then try again.
source.k210.flash.err.generic: Flashing failed. Unplug and re-plug the USB cable and try again. See the log for details.
